method: Nine seeded10-minute normal20-occupant worlds, one human-flagged probe using ordinary BotBrain plus19 bots, all normal field/hazards/weapons and actor rules. Only process-local PEER_HIT_SHARE changes:0 legacy/.25 floor/.33 floor. Frames distinguish flying deaths from body deaths; current-leader death is rank at previous frame, not every former leader. No forced fights or guarantee of hit, no human fun or hours-long survival proof. Cannon credits include spent-missile events and are not hit counts; accuracy is measured separately.
